answer.reason: The site's main navigation is rendered from the Header content list, and each top-level entry in that list is an item of the "Top Level Nav" model (referenceName: TopLevelNav). This model has a required "Link" field for the main nav item (href + label) plus optional sub-nav links and bottom links — exactly matching a new top-level menu entry like "Docs". I did not save anything, only inspected the content models (TopLevelNav, Header, NavLink) and sitemaps to determine the right target.
